datadog_agent_runtime

Module env 

Source
Expand description

Environment providers backed by the Datadog Agent.

RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider gives a remote agent its hostname, autodiscovery events, and workload metadata. In connected mode, each of those comes from the Datadog Agent over its own connection. In standalone mode, the hostname is fixed and the rest is unavailable.
